updates.sentence: A June 27, 1961 official interview report confirms confinement in Parchman penitentiary following the June Freedom Ride arrest. An archival summary citing the June 30 Chicago Tribune reports a $200 fine and four-month sentence for both Pleune sisters. June incarceration is recorded at month precision; exact admission and physical release dates remain unresolved. The sentence is not a verified time-served total.
